stops.note: named after Gyaman King Nana Kwadwo Agyemang Adinkra; the Twi root also carries the sense of "farewell", tied to the symbols' funerary origins
stops.meaning: farewell; symbols stamped on funerary cloth

stops.note: adopted by English-language art historians and textile scholars to name the Akan symbol system
stops.meaning: a system of symbolic Akan visual symbols

current_meaning: a set of symbolic West African (Akan) visual symbols representing concepts or proverbs, especially printed on cloth
